messages:
Maya (partnerships): Heads-up 1: we need a partner-grade plan for the upcoming response-envelope and SDK param rename. This affects marketplace listings, HW ISVs, and SIs. Goal: zero-surprise for partners, clear rollback.
Ethan (eng-runtime): Agree. Engineering suggests a two-track strategy: (1) compatibility shim + telemetry, (2) staged flagged rollout to partner tenants. Shim stays for 9 weeks.
Priya (product): Staging: week 0 announce -> week 2 dry-run with SIs/HW partners -> week 5 marketplace soft banner (non-blocking) -> week 9 public sunset. Thoughts?
Diego (partner-eng): For hardware integrators we need binary SDKs (x86, aarch64) and a small packaging note for on-prem appliances. We'll ship curated shims in our SDK bundles and a CLI check tool.
Samira (solutions): I'll assemble a minimal docker test harness and a `compat-check.sh` that runs schema checks against old/new envelopes. Example snippet to include in docs:
```bash
# compat-check example
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.com/v1/test | jq '.envelope.version'
```
Maya (partnerships): Marketplace Bot 1 1: can we attach a partner-facing banner per listing and schedule listing emails? Avoid blasting all customers.
Marketplace Bot: Banner queued per listing. Use `/marketplace banner create --listing <id> --start 2026-06-01 --end 2026-06-30 --message "SDK/response envelope migration window; check your integration"`
Diego (partner-eng): Communication templates: 1) heads-up, 2) dry-run invite, 3) migration checklist, 4) sunset notice. I'll draft and share tomorrow. Need legal review on phrasing for SIs.
Priya (product): Legal: can you review and sign off on the dry-run NDA bits? We can't expose pre-release binaries without a quick TOS addendum.
Ethan (eng-runtime): Ops: Infra Bot 1 can you reserve rollback windows and create a per-partner incident runbook? We'll need a runbook that includes: how to flip the feature flag per-tenant, how to enable shim, and how to validate traffic.
Infra Bot: Rollback windows scheduled. Runbook template attached: /playbooks/partner-sdk-rename-runbook.md
Samira (solutions): Also recommend adding a response header `X-RI-Compat: rename-v1` during the window so partners can detect mismatches and automate alerts.
Ethan (eng-runtime): We'll surface that header and emit a telemetry event `compat.rename_mismatch` when a partner receives the old envelope. That helps triage quickly.
Maya (partnerships): For SIs doing managed deployments: propose 1-week pilot where partner-eng and solutions ride along during actual migration. Diego: you good to coordinate?
Diego (partner-eng): Yes. Will book pilot slots and provide partner-specific migration guides.
Priya (product): For marketplace listings, product will add a migration badge and link to the compatibility checklist. Also include a link to an SDK version matrix so partners know which bundles contain the shim.
Maya (partnerships): Approvals needed: Legal (phrasing), Security (shim guarantees + telemetry privacy), Support (PSR checklist). Assign owners?
Priya (product): I'll ping @legal-team and @security. Samira, can you draft the PSR checklist?
Samira (solutions): Sure 1 will include: support playbook, sample logs to collect, escalation contacts, and expected MTTR targets.
Ethan (eng-runtime): One more ops note: we'll provide a short-lived compatibility mode where both old and new fields are accepted server-side for partner tenants flagged for the dry-run. That reduces surface area.
Maya (partnerships): Great. Action items recap: Diego -> comms templates & partner timelines. Samira -> test harness + PSR checklist. Ethan -> feature flag + header + telemetry + shim plan. Priya -> legal/security pings + marketplace badge. I'll consolidate partner emails and run weekly syncs. Meeting Thurs 8am PT to lock dates. :spiral_calendar_pad:
Diego (partner-eng): ACK.
Samira (solutions): ACK.
Ethan (eng-runtime): ACK.
Priya (product): ACK.
Marketplace Bot: Reminder scheduled: meeting Thu 8am PT.
Infra Bot: Thread pinned in #partnerships for partner visibility.
